confirmed.title: Closing/cancelling an order via the drawer's edit modal never restores stock — save patches the new status before settleReturnStock runs, so the closed→closed guard always fires (regression since 9e1f469)
confirmed.repro: Order with status 確認済み or レンタル中 and stockDeducted=true (stock deducted at 受注確定). Admin opens the order in AdminRental (or any of the 7 drawer hosts) → 注文情報を編集 → change 注文ステータス to キャンセル (pre-delivery cancel), 返却済, or 完了 → 保存する. handleSaveEdit calls onUpdateOrder first (line 400), whose host wiring does OrderBus.patch synchronously (orderBus.ts:655-667 writes _mem immediately), setting the live order's status to the closed value. Only then does it call onUpdateStatus (line 406-408), whose host wiring runs settleReturnStock(raw, status) — but raw is re-read from OrderBus.getAll and already has the closed status, so the closed→closed guard at src/utils/stockLedger.ts:212 (`if (isClosedOrder(liveCur?.status)) return {}`) returns {} before restoreOrderStock ever runs. Result: no stockIn 伝票, products.stock not incremented, stockRestored never set.
confirmed.impact: Permanent physical-stock loss in the ledger every time an admin closes or cancels an out-on-loan order through the edit modal — which is the ONLY UI path to cancel an already-accepted order in AdminRental (却下 exists only in the 受注待ち queue). The comment at AdminOrderDrawer.tsx:401-404 states the explicit intent that this call must return stock ('これをしないと、出庫済み注文をモーダルでキャンセルしても在庫が戻らない'), so this is an unintended regression introduced when the closed→closed guard landed in commit 9e1f469 (2026-06-23). Affects all 7 host pages (AdminRental, AdminSales, AdminWarehouse, AdminCalendar, AdminInvoices, AdminRecovery, AdminDashboardHome) since they share identical wiring. Direct status buttons (手配する, AdminRecovery buttons) are unaffected because they call the ledger before patching.
confirmed.proposed_fix: In src/components/AdminOrderDrawer.tsx handleSaveEdit: run the ledger transition BEFORE the status is persisted for closing transitions. Concretely, before line 400 add: `const statusChanged = (updates.status || order.status) !== order.status; const closing = statusChanged && isClosedOrder(updates.status); if (closing && onUpdateStatus) onUpdateStatus(order.firestoreId || order.id, updates.status, updates.staffStatus || undefined);` then call `onUpdateOrder(...)`, and keep the existing post-save `onUpdateStatus` call only for the non-closing case (e.g. →確認済み deduct, which must stay AFTER onUpdateOrder so deductOrderStock's stockDeductedQty patch lands on the edited items and is not overwritten by normalizedItems). Import isClosedOrder from ../utils/orderStatus. Alternatively (more robust): add a prevStatus parameter to settleReturnStock (src/utils/stockLedger.ts:205) and use `isClosedOrder(prevStatus ?? liveCur?.status)` in the line-212 guard, passing order.status (the pre-edit snapshot) from the drawer through onUpdateStatus.
reasons: Claim verified, not refutable. AdminOrderDrawer.tsx:400 calls onUpdateOrder before onUpdateStatus (line 406-408); host wiring (e.g. AdminRental.tsx:380-381) does OrderBus.patch which synchronously writes _mem (orderBus.ts:655-667, _write at 264-267), so the live order already carries the closed status when settleReturnStock runs. confirmed.title: Registered rental contracts get a 4-digit random orderNumber (RN-YYYY-1000..9999) with no uniqueness check; on collision, stockLedger's resolveLiveOrder orderNumber-fallback resolves the WRONG order, corrupting stock flags and items
confirmed.repro: Register rental contracts via レンタル契約を登録 over time: orderNumber = `RN-${year}-${Math.floor(1000+Math.random()*9000)}` has only 9,000 values per year (birthday paradox: ~10% chance of a duplicate at 43 registrations, ~50% at 112). Once two orders share e.g. RN-2026-1234: resolveLiveOrder (src/utils/stockLedger.ts:66) uses `list.find(o => o.id===id || o.firestoreId===id || (num && o.orderNumber===num))` — find() returns the FIRST record matching ANY predicate, so if the colliding other order precedes the target in _mem (push prepends newest first), every deduct/restore guard reads the OTHER order's flags. Concrete: active RN order awaiting final inspection + a later-registered historical 返却済 contract that collides (historical has stockDeducted=true, stockRestored=true per design) → restoreOrderStock's guard (stockLedger.ts:152) sees stockRestored=true on the wrong record → final-inspection restock silently skipped. Also deductOrderStock (stockLedger.ts:82,125) patches `{stockDeducted, items}` onto the wrong order's id — overwriting an unrelated order's item list.
confirmed.impact: Probabilistic but destructive: permanent stock shortfall (skipped restore) or skipped deduction, and cross-order item-list corruption via the wrong-target patch. Also duplicate invoice numbers (INV-R-<digits of orderNumber> in AdminDataContext.tsx:191) and colliding stockOut/stockIn 伝票 refs, making the ledger un-auditable for those orders.
confirmed.proposed_fix: Two changes: (1) src/pages/Admin/AdminRental.tsx:160 — make orderNumber collision-free like the checkout path (OrderContext.tsx:113 uses Date.now()): e.g. `const orderNumber = \`RN-${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getTime()).slice(-6)}\`;` or re-roll while `OrderBus.getAll('orders').some(o => o.orderNumber === orderNumber)`. (2) Harden src/utils/stockLedger.ts resolveLiveOrder (line 61-67) to prefer exact id matches: first `list.find(o => o.id===id || o.firestoreId===id)`, and only if that returns nothing fall back to `list.find(o => num && o.orderNumber===num)`.
reasons: Claim verified against current code, cannot refute. (1) AdminRental.tsx:160 generates orderNumber as RN-<year>-<4-digit Math.random()> with no uniqueness check anywhere in the repo (grep confirms; git history has no fix; the exclusion-list item about stable RN-<time36>-<rand> covers only the order *id* at line 163, not orderNumber). (2) stockLedger.ts:66 resolveLiveOrder uses list.find(o => o.id===id || o.firestoreId===id || (num && o.orderNumber===num)); orderBus.ts:645-646 confirms push PREPENDS (newest first), so a later-registered colliding order shadows an earlier one. (3) Reachable corruption paths confirmed: (a) ordering-independent — every RN order is born with stockDeducted=true (AdminRental.tsx:193 or :196/:205), so registering a new active contract with a colliding number makes deductOrderStock(seed) resolve the OLD order by orderNumber (seed id not yet pushed), hit wasDeducted at stockLedger.ts:79, and return {} — stock never decremented for the new contract, no stockOut voucher; (b) the claimed restore-skip — a later historical 返却済 registration (stockRestored=true, AdminRental.tsx:193) colliding with an active order awaiting inspection precedes it in _mem, so restoreOrderStock's guard at stockLedger.ts:151-152 reads the wrong record and skips the final-inspection restock (live admin callers: AdminRecovery.tsx:258 settleReturnStock, AdminWarehouse.tsx:1035, AdminRental.tsx:375, AdminCalendar.tsx:539, AdminInvoices.tsx:614); (c) stockLedger.ts:82/:125 patch stockDeducted/items onto the mis-resolved order's id, overwriting an unrelated order. (4) AdminDataContext.tsx:191 derives INV-R- from orderNumber digits, so collisions also duplicate invoice numbers and stockOut/stockIn refs (stockLedger.ts:86/:161). Probabilistic (birthday math ~9.5% at 43 registrations/year is correct) but the mechanism and impact are real and unguarded.

confirmed.title: Editing any billing field in the drawer discards cached invoiceBlocks wholesale, silently deleting manually-added 追加費用 and 入金済み (paid/paidAt) marks

The ¥5,000 manual cost disappears from all invoices and from updates.subtotal/tax/total (lines 389-397), and the previously-paid month reverts to 未入金.
confirmed.impact: Silent loss of billed money (manual extra costs vanish from invoices and totals) and loss of payment-tracking state — a paid month reappears as outstanding in the AR list, risking double collection attempts and unauditable paidAt history. Triggered by a routine, legitimate operation (extending a rental period).

Sketch: `const regenerated = getOrGenerateInvoiceBlocks(tempOrder); const AUTO = new Set(['fuel-refill','compensation-charge','delivery-fee']); const old = order.invoiceBlocks || []; const merged = regenerated.map(b => { const prev = old.find(o => o.monthPeriod === b.monthPeriod); if (!prev) return b; const manual = (prev.extraCosts||[]).filter(c => !AUTO.has(c.id)); return recalculateInvoiceBlock({ ...b, extraCosts: [...(b.extraCosts||[]), ...manual], status: prev.status === 'paid' ? 'paid' : b.status, ...(prev.paidAt ? { paidAt: prev.paidAt } : {}) }); }); updates.invoiceBlocks = merged;` then compute sums from merged instead of `blocks`.

confirmed.title: invoiceBlocks regeneration (customer extension / return finalization) silently discards admin-added extraCosts and reverts paid blocks to pending

confirmed.title: OrderBus.patch upserts the full record built from a ≤3s-stale local copy — concurrent staff writes are silently erased (lost update, LWW)
confirmed.repro: 1) Staff APK completes a delivery: patch adds deliveryConfirmedAt, deliveryPhotos/signature URLs, staffStatus="配送完了", status="レンタル中" to order X; server row updated. 2) Admin's OrderBus last polled /api/sync before that write (poll interval SYNC_POLL_MS=3000, window widened further because _applyRemoteChanges skips records in _pendingUpserts while admin's own upsert is in flight). 3) Within that window admin saves the AdminOrderDrawer (onUpdateOrder → patchOrder → OrderBus.patch merges only the edited fields onto the stale local copy) → _upsertExternalized POSTs the ENTIRE merged record → store.php:200 `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE data = VALUES(data)` fully replaces server data. Result: staff's completion fields are gone server-wide; on staff's next poll its local copy is overwritten too, the delivery job reappears as incomplete and photos/signature evidence is lost permanently.
confirmed.impact: Silent, permanent loss of concurrently-written order fields — most damaging for staff delivery/collection records (photos, signatures, timestamps that drive billing start) and for two-admin concurrent edits. No error is surfaced anywhere; the server has a rev column but no write uses it for concurrency control.
confirmed.proposed_fix: Add optimistic concurrency: include the record's last-seen rev in apiUpsert (orderBus.ts _upsertExternalized, src/lib/backendSync.ts apiUpsert) and have store.php POST reject with 409 when the stored rev differs; on 409 the client re-fetches the row, re-applies only the patch's `updates` keys on top, and retries. Lighter alternative confined to patch(): before apiUpsert, GET the single record from the server and re-merge `updates` onto the fresh server copy (patch already tracks the exact update keys), which shrinks the clobber window from seconds to the request RTT.
reasons: Claim confirmed, not refutable. OrderBus.patch (src/lib/orderBus.ts:655-671) shallow-merges only the edited fields onto the ≤3s-stale local _mem copy (SYNC_POLL_MS=3000, src/lib/dataBackend.ts:16) and _upsertExternalized POSTs the entire merged record (orderBus.ts:582 → backendSync.ts:34); store.php:199-203 does `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE data = VALUES(data)` — full JSON replacement with no merge and no optimistic-concurrency use of the rev column (rev is only a sync cursor via next_rev). The window-widening mechanism is real: _applyRemoteChanges (orderBus.ts:417) skips incoming changes for records in _pendingUpserts while the admin's own upsert is in flight. No guard, no refetch-before-save, nothing in the KNOWN/INTENTIONAL list covers this, and no fix exists on the current branch. Only nitpick: externalized image files persist on the server, but the record's references to them are lost, so evidence is effectively unrecoverable through the app.

confirmed.title: 却下 (reject) in AdminRental/AdminSales never checks the live order status and never restores stock — cancelling a just-accepted order permanently leaks deducted inventory

confirmed.title: useServerQuery.loadMore appends without dedupe while the server pages by ORDER BY rev DESC — any concurrent write shifts the window, producing duplicate rows / duplicate React keys and skipped orders until the next poll
confirmed.repro: AdminRental 完了・取消 queue with >50 matching orders. Load page 1 (offset 0, rev DESC per public/api/query.php:103). Any client then updates ANY order in the filtered set (staff completion, partial return, admin edit — every write bumps rev and moves that row to position 0). Click さらに表示 → loadMore fetches offset=50 of the now-shifted ordering and `setRows(prev => [...prev, ...r.rows])` appends verbatim → one order appears twice in the table (React duplicate-key warning, since rows are keyed by firestoreId||id) and one order is silently missing from the combined list until the 8s poller replaces the whole window.
confirmed.impact: Admin sees duplicated orders and can miss an order entirely in paged views for up to 8s per occurrence; with active field staff constantly bumping revs this happens routinely while paging. (Distinct from the known-deferred 500-row cap #9 — this is ordering drift, not the window limit.)
confirmed.proposed_fix: In loadMore (src/lib/ordersQuery.ts:84), dedupe on append: `setRows(prev => { const seen = new Set(prev.map(r => String(r.firestoreId || r.id))); return [...prev, ...r.rows.filter(nr => !seen.has(String(nr.firestoreId || nr.id)))]; })`. For the skipped-row half, page with a rev cursor instead of offset (client passes the smallest rev received; query.php adds `AND rev < ?` with the same ORDER BY), which makes pages stable under concurrent writes.
reasons: Claim verified against current code, cannot refute. (1) Every write assigns a fresh global monotonic rev (public/api/store.php:198-203 via next_rev, db.php:192-195), so a written row jumps to position 0 of ORDER BY rev DESC (public/api/query.php:103). (2) loadMore fetches offset=rows.length and appends verbatim with no dedupe (src/lib/ordersQuery.ts:83-84); rows keyed by firestoreId||id (src/pages/Admin/AdminRental.tsx:300); さらに表示 calls loadMore (AdminRental.tsx:354-361). (3) When a write inserts/moves an order into the filtered set from beyond the loaded window (staff completion or partial-return -R entering the 完了・取消 queue, admin edit of an unloaded closed order), all loaded positions shift down by one, so offset=50 re-returns the row formerly at position 49 → duplicate row + duplicate React key, and the bumped order at position 0 is missing until the next 8s poll replaces the window (ordersQuery.ts:96-111); an in-flight poll at loadMore time is discarded by the applyGenRef bump (lines 81,105), so the duplicate persists a full poll cycle. Only caveat: writes to rows ALREADY inside the loaded 0..49 window do not shift positions ≥50, so "ANY order in the filtered set" is mildly overstated — but the claim's own examples (staff completion, partial return, edits) are the shifting kind, so the repro stands. Not on the exclusion list (distinct from the #9 500-row cap) and not fixed at HEAD.

Claim confirmed, cannot refute. src/lib/ordersQuery.ts:83-84 fetches offset=rows.length and appends verbatim (setRows(prev => [...prev, ...r.rows])) with no id dedupe; public/api/query.php pages via ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT/OFFSET and public/api/store.php:198/327 assigns a global next_rev on every POST/DELETE, so any write that adds/moves a matching row into the top of the ordering (staff completion entering the 完了・取消 set, edit of a not-yet-loaded order, new order) shifts all loaded rows down one; loadMore then re-fetches the old boundary row (duplicate) while the moved row stays unfetched until the 8s poller replaces the window (ordersQuery.ts:96-111). AdminRental.tsx:97/300/354-357 renders rows unfiltered keyed by firestoreId||id with a reachable さらに表示 button, so duplicate React keys and a temporarily missing order occur exactly as described. The applyGenRef generation guard only discards stale responses, not window drift. Not in the exclusion list (#9 covers only the 500-row cap, a different defect) and not fixed on this branch. Minor imprecision only: updating a row already inside the loaded page does NOT shift the offset boundary — the drift requires a write to an unloaded matching row, a row entering/leaving the filter set, or a new insert — but those are the routine cases the repro cites, so the claim stands.

plausible.title: deductOrderStock returns stockDeducted:true without recording stockDeductedQty=0 when the product lookup fails, so a later final-inspection restore adds stock that was never deducted
plausible.repro: Order contains a rent item whose product cannot be resolved at 受注確定 time — e.g. the product was deleted from the products master after the order was placed, or the products store hasn't synced yet in a fresh session. deductOrderStock: adjustProductStock returns null → `if (!prod) return;` (line 98) exits BEFORE `it.stockDeductedQty = actual` (line 105), yet the function still returns { stockDeducted: true } (line 127) and no warning fires (the 在庫不足 warn at line 108 is also skipped). Months later the product is re-created in the master under the same name; the order is returned and passes warehouse 最終検品 → restoreOrderStock line 166 falls back to `cap = it.quantity` because stockDeductedQty is null, finds the product BY NAME (adjustProductStock matches id OR name), and adds the full quantity to products.stock — stock that was never taken out.
plausible.impact: Silent phantom-stock inflation (the exact failure class this codebase repeatedly hardened against: closed→closed ghost-stock guard, stockDeductedQty draw-down). Books show more physical inventory than exists; subsequent orders get accepted against nonexistent stock.
plausible.proposed_fix: In deductOrderStock (src/utils/stockLedger.ts:97-98), set the ledger fact before skipping: `if (!prod) { it.stockDeductedQty = 0; return; }` — so the restore cap at line 166 correctly evaluates to 0 for items that never left the ledger. This does not affect legacy orders (they have no stockDeductedQty and intentionally keep the quantity fallback) nor vehicles (restore also skips them, but the explicit 0 makes the ledger consistent even if such an item is later added to products).
reasons:
REFUTED — the skip is documented intentional design, and both repro legs fail scrutiny.

(1) Intentional design, documented at both ends. src/utils/stockLedger.ts:96-98 explicitly documents the early-return: 「products に無い品目（車両等）は現物在庫対象外。伝票も作らない。」, and line 126 documents that stockDeducted:true is deliberately returned even when nothing moved: 「品目が無くても『処理済み』として印を付け、再呼び出しでの二重減算を防ぐ」. stockDeducted is a "stock processing done" marker, not a per-quantity receipt — the codebase already uses it this way elsewhere (AdminRentalRegisterModal historical registrations set stockDeducted+stockRestored with zero movement, listed as intentional). The designed case (vehicles etc. never in products) is symmetric: restoreOrderStock also fails the lookup and warns (stockLedger.ts:193). The claimed no-warning at deduct is likewise intentional — warning on every vehicle line would be constant noise.

(2) The primary repro (delete product → re-create same name months later) requires a chain of admin master-data errors, and under correct data entry the current fallback produces the CORRECT book. products.stock is defined as 現物在庫/physical on-hand (stockLedger.ts:4). When the admin re-creates the product, the correct entry is the current physical warehouse count, which excludes the units out on rent; at 最終検品 the goods physically re-enter the warehouse, so the +quantity restore at lines 166/170 (with an auditable stockIn ticket) is physically right. Inflation only occurs if the admin re-enters a stock figure that wrongly includes the rented-out units — a data-entry error the ledger cannot see. Conversely, the claim's implied fix (record stockDeductedQty=0 → cap=0 → back=0) would SILENTLY (back>0 gates the line-193 warning) under-count stock by the full returned quantity in the correct-entry case, i.e. it trades a hypothetical inflation caused by bad data entry for a guaranteed silent shortage under good data entry. The line-166 null fallback to quantity is deliberate legacy compat (pre-stockDeductedQty orders were deducted in full); the stockDeductedQty draw-down work is listed as complete in the known-fixed list.

(3) The secondary repro ("products store hasn't synced in a fresh session") cannot persist the corrupt state in any realistic window. In a cold session the orders store is equally unsynced, and AdminRental's handleAccept persists flags via liveOrders.patchOrder → OrderBus.patch (src/context/AdminDataContext.tsx:81-83), which no-ops when the order record is absent from the local store (orderBus.ts patch: `if (idx >= 0)` only) — so neither status nor stockDeducted reaches the server; the order stays 受注待ち and is re-accepted after sync, when products are present. Orders and products arrive in the SAME apiSync(0) response applied in one tick (public/api/sync.php:12, single query over all stores) for datasets under the 5000-rev window; the corrupt persistence would additionally require a >5000-record cold sync whose window boundary happens to deliver the just-placed order (high rev) in an earlier window than its product — impossible unless the product's rev is even higher, i.e. the product was modified after the order was placed — plus the admin locating the order, clicking 受注確定 and confirming the dialog inside the seconds-long inter-tick gap of the initial sync. That is a compound race, not a reproducible defect.

Claim verified, not refutable. src/utils/stockLedger.ts:97-98: when adjustProductStock returns null, the per-item callback exits before it.stockDeductedQty = actual (line 105) and before the 在庫不足 warn (line 108), yet deductOrderStock still returns { stockDeducted: true } (line 127). At restore, line 166 falls back to cap = it.quantity when stockDeductedQty is null, and adjustProductStock (line 37) matches by id OR name, so a product re-created under the same name receives a full-quantity stock credit that was never deducted. Repro is possible: AdminProductManagement.tsx:215-219 deletes products with only a confirm dialog (no open-order guard), AdminRental.tsx:107-119 handleAccept calls deductOrderStock with no product-resolution validation, and settleReturnStock (stockLedger.ts:205-223) performs the restore on the first unclosed→closed transition entirely within the admin site. A secondary cold-cache path also exists (orderBus.ts _read returns [] for products pre-sync while AdminRental rows render from useServerQuery). Not intentional: the skip is documented only for items permanently absent from products (vehicles, 別管理), which also fail lookup at restore (warn at line 193); the inflating absent-then-present combination violates the codebase's own documented invariant (comments at lines 102 and 165: never restore more than actually deducted, 在庫水増し防止) — the same invariant already enforced for the fixed 0-clamp over-restock case. No existing fix or exclusion-list item covers it; returnProcessing.ts draw-down (lines 233-237) explicitly leaves stockDeductedQty==null items untouched. Minimal fix would be setting it.stockDeductedQty = 0 before the early return at line 98 (harmless for vehicle-type items).
